items.stem: In Figure, DE ∥ BC. Find the length of side AD, given that AE = 1.8 cm, BD = 7.2 cm and CE = 5.4 cm.
items.answer: Since DE ∥ BC, the Basic Proportionality Theorem gives AD/DB = AE/EC. Substituting the given lengths, AD/7.2 = 1.8/5.4, so AD = (1.8 × 7.2)/5.4 = 12.96/5.4. Hence AD = 2.4 cm.
items.ocr: Figure printed beside the question carries the three given lengths; attached because the stem says "In Figure".

items.stem: What is the value of x in given figure?
items.answer: In ΔKPN and ΔKLM, ∠K is common and ∠KNP = ∠KML = 46°, so by the AA criterion of similarity ΔKNP ∼ ΔKML. Therefore KN/KM = NP/ML, that is c/(b + c) = x/a. Hence x = ac/(b + c).
items.ocr: Stem is unanswerable without the figure - a, b, c and the two 46° angles appear only on the diagram. Its worked solution continues on the next printed page.

items.stem: ΔABC and ΔBDE are two equilateral triangle such that D is the mid-point of BC. Ratio of the areas of triangles ABC and BDE is ................. .
items.answer: Both triangles are equilateral, so area(ΔABC)/area(ΔBDE) = [(√3/4)(BC)²]/[(√3/4)(BD)²] = (BC)²/(½BC)² = 4BC²/BC² = 4/1. Hence the ratio of the areas is 4 : 1.

items.stem: Two triangles are similar if their corresponding sides are ............... .
items.answer: Two triangles are similar when their corresponding sides are proportional. So the blank is filled by: in the same ratio.

items.stem: In ΔABC, DE ∥ BC, find the value of x.
items.answer: Since DE ∥ BC, by the Basic Proportionality Theorem AD/DB = AE/EC. From the figure AD = x, DB = x + 1, AE = x + 3 and EC = x + 5, so x/(x + 1) = (x + 3)/(x + 5). Cross-multiplying, x² + 5x = x² + 4x + 3, hence x = 3.

items.stem: In the given figure, if ∠A = 90°, ∠B = 90°, OB = 4.5 cm, OA = 6 cm and AP = 4 cm then find QB.
items.answer: In ΔPAO and ΔQBO we have ∠A = ∠B = 90°, and ∠POA = ∠QOB because they are vertically opposite angles. So ΔPAO ∼ ΔQBO by the AA criterion, giving OA/OB = PA/QB. Thus 6/4.5 = 4/QB, so QB = (4 × 4.5)/6 = 3 cm.

items.stem: Are two triangles with equal corresponding sides always similar?
items.answer: Yes. Two triangles having equal corresponding sides are congruent, and congruent triangles have equal corresponding angles as well, so they are similar too.

items.stem: The perimeters of two similar triangles are 25 cm and 15 cm respectively. If one side of the first triangle is 9 cm, then the corresponding side of second triangle is ................... .
items.answer: The ratio of the perimeters of two similar triangles is equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides. So 25/15 = 9/side, which gives side = (9 × 15)/25 = 5.4 cm.

items.stem: In ΔABC, if X and Y are points on AB and AC respectively such that AX/XB = 3/4, AY = 5 and YC = 9, then state whether XY and BC parallel or not.
items.answer: Here AX/XB = 3/4, while AY/YC = 5/9. Since 3/4 ≠ 5/9 the two ratios are not equal, so by the converse of the Basic Proportionality Theorem XY is not parallel to BC.

items.stem: If triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF such that 2AB = DE and BC = 8 cm then find EF.
items.answer: Since ΔABC ∼ ΔDEF, corresponding sides are proportional, so AB/BC = DE/EF. Putting DE = 2AB and BC = 8 cm gives AB/8 = 2AB/EF, hence EF = 2 × 8 = 16 cm.
items.ocr: No board/year tag is printed against this item. The two triangles shown are drawn in the solution, so they are not attached.

items.stem: In the figure, PQ is parallel to MN. If KP/PM = 4/13 and KN = 20.4 cm then find KQ.
items.answer: Since PQ ∥ MN, by the Basic Proportionality Theorem KP/PM = KQ/QN = KQ/(KN − KQ). So 4/13 = KQ/(20.4 − KQ), giving 4 × 20.4 − 4KQ = 13KQ, hence 17KQ = 81.6 and KQ = 81.6/17 = 4.8 cm.
items.ocr: Figure names the points K, P, Q, M and N used in the stem and is printed above the solution, so it is attached.

items.stem: In Figure, in ΔABC, DE ∥ BC such that AD = 2.4 cm, AB = 3.2 cm and AC = 8 cm, then what is the length of AE?
items.answer: Since DE ∥ BC, by the Basic Proportionality Theorem AD/DB = AE/EC. Adding 1 to both sides gives AD/(AD + DB) = AE/(AE + EC), that is AD/AB = AE/AC. So 2.4/3.2 = AE/8, which gives AE = 6 cm.
